about: Every value the Paste-style frames draw. Numbers are pixels: on the 1320x2868 canvas for anything on the ground, in the capture's own pixels for anything inside a screen or a lifted tile. Strings are CSS values as written. build.py writes each leaf under base as a custom property on :root and each per-element value on its element; paste_style.css draws from those only.

capture.note: every capture is 1320x2868; its keyboard's own corner is 187 px, so the screen clip follows it

card.note: the store search card shows a frame about 300 px wide; Paste's first headline is 32 px there

bubble.note: drawn, not captured: one incoming Messages bubble, 108 px tall, ending 69 px above the field

free_box.note: the capture's empty chat area; the bubble must stay inside it

patches.what: the test page's 'localhost' pill, covered with the page's own white
the charging battery, replaced by the plain status icons of the chat capture
the Bank Account key, replaced by the Phone Number key in the same slot of the chat capture

S1.pull: Whole phones, tiles cross: every phone stays whole in its own frame, and a tile lifted from the library in frame 2 crosses each seam to dock beside the place it was pasted

lifts.what: the Home Address tile, crossing seam 1|2: it leaves the library's margin and lands on the empty part of the chat

patches.what: the tile's top 44 px sit under the library's header in the capture; the same strip of the tile below takes their place

lifts.what: the Email Signature tile, crossing seam 2|3 beside its own slot in the library: it lands on the mail's left margin

S2.pull: Paste to the letter: one device far larger than the rest fills frame 2 and runs over both seams, the way Paste's MacBook does

ledger.item: We just crop the keyboard, and badly: stop doing that
Remake it in the rivals' style (Paste is the one to beat)
Calm light ground
One big bold headline at the top, in plain words
The whole iPhone with its bezel, shown large
Lots of air
Optionally a small proof line
ledger.dropped: No award, rating or press line is on disk to quote, and App Review 2.3.7 bars pricing words from metadata, so 'pay once' is out too. The grey line under the headline says how it works instead (f1.sub).

ledger.item: Use the whole real capture inside a phone, never a keyboard panel
Brand colour is mint; a light ground with green as accent is fine
Output is 1320x2868
A flat marketing image, no status bar of our own on top
ledger.dropped: Nothing is drawn above the headline; the only status bar is the one inside the capture.

ledger.item: Owner-approved idea 'Paste your bank number in one tap'; the capture shows an address
Buyer copy states the result, not features; about two short lines
A convincing iPhone 17 Pro-style bezel drawn in CSS, no third-party mockup
The Dynamic Island is already in the capture
ledger.dropped: No island is drawn; the capture's own shows through the uncropped screen.

ledger.item: The headline reads at about 300 px wide
Nothing is cropped awkwardly; the phone is whole and sharp
The rest of the set and the locales render from the same template
Tap a saved snippet on the keyboard and it is pasted into any app (built: the capture shows the address pasted into Messages)
Save it once (built: iphone-new.png is the save screen)
Headline column is the phone's column, so the words and the device share both edges
The green of 'one tap' and the mark on the tapped key are one accent
The bleed through other pictures effect? (Paste's panorama: one picture running across neighbouring screenshots)
Everything considered? (every rival technique weighed)
Frames 1-3 are one continuous composition
At least one element crosses each seam
Each frame still works alone on the product page
The remaining frames may continue the strip
ledger.dropped: Only frames 1-3 are drawn. A fourth frame continues the strip by adding a frame, a phone and a lift to spec.json.

ledger.item: Keep the near-white calm and the single green accent unless the audit says otherwise
The empty chat: use the real capture and add only honest content that looks like the app (an incoming Messages bubble)
The 09.41 clock reads 9:41
Check that search results show the first three portrait screenshots side by side
Everything you retype kept in one library (built: iphone-grid-clean.png is the library)
Paste in any app (built: the keyboard works in any text field; the capture on disk is a test page laid out as a mail composer, not Mail itself)
The two lifted tiles are the two things pasted: Home Address towards the chat, Email Signature towards the mail
